scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d --wait kafka mongo && docker compose run --rm kafka-init
scripts.start: pnpm infra:up && concurrently -k -n sim,proy,notif,reprog,sla,analitica,web -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,red,cyan,white "pnpm dev:simulator" "pnpm dev:projector" "pnpm dev:notifications" "pnpm dev:rescheduling" "pnpm dev:sla" "pnpm dev:analytics" "pnpm dev:web"

scripts.start:cu2: pnpm infra:up && concurrently -k -n sim,proy,notif,reprog,analitica -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan "pnpm dev:simulator" "pnpm dev:projector" "pnpm dev:notifications" "pnpm dev:rescheduling" "pnpm dev:analytics"
